question: A wire of length '$l$' and resistance $100\ \Omega$ is divided into $10$ equal parts. The first $5$ parts are connected in series while the next $5$ parts are connected in parallel. The two combinations are again connected in series. The resistance of this final combination is:
solution:
Each part has resistance $\dfrac{100}{10} = 10\ \Omega$.

Five in series: $5 \times 10 = 50\ \Omega$.

Five in parallel: $\dfrac{10}{5} = 2\ \Omega$.

Total: $50 + 2 = 52\ \Omega$.
